newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Remediation unit buys TriTechnics.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Remediation unit buys TriTechnics.

text.p: Thermo Remediation Inc said on Monday that its subsidiary Remediation Technologies Inc had acquired privately owned TriTechnics Corp for about $1.6 million in cash.

"With this acquisition we have considerably broadened our service offerings and strengthened our capabilities in the Rocky Mountain region," said Jeffrey Powell, president and chief operating officer of Thermo Remediation.

TriTechnics is an environmental engineering and consulting firm with 40 employees at offices in Golden, Colorado, and Salt Lake City, Utah. TriTechnics had 1996 gross revenues of $4.3 million, Thermo Remediation said in a statement.

Thermo Remediation Inc is a national provider of environmental services, such as resource recovery and recycling. Thermo Remediation is a public subsidiary of Thermo TerraTech Inc, a Thermo Electron Corp company.
